explanation: The English article says that a supplementary decree to the Nuremberg Laws, issued on 26 November 1935, classified Roma as "enemies of the race-based state", "thereby placing them in the same category as the Jews", and that thus the fate of the Sinti and Roma in Europe paralleled that of the Jews in the Holocaust. What is claimed here is that the racial law and the apparatus built for the persecution this atlas records as the Holocaust were extended to the Roma, and not that one genocide caused the other: the article dates the persecution of Roma from 1933, alongside rather than after.
